verified_points: All 55 tests passed in an isolated /tmp copy. All 13 formal mutants failed their target assertions; none was killed by an import or execution error.
A fresh rebuild from source, tests, and static supporting audit reproduced metrics.json, RESULTS.md, fixtures/MANIFEST.json, and all 18 gold JSON files byte-for-byte.
The rebuilt experiment-run records start 2026-09-15T07:16:02.662460+00:00 and finish 2026-09-15T07:16:02.783298+00:00. The stored run also has finish greater than start.

Independent controlled-clock probes verified start -> EV1 return -> EV2 return -> EV3 return -> EV4 return -> EV5 return -> EV6 return -> EV7 return -> finish. Injected failures in each EV prevented finish sampling.
The new timestamp regression killed separate mutants that sampled finish before all experiments and immediately before EV7.

All four Academic Round2 artifact hashes and all five preserved review-verdict hashes match pre-review-06-audit.json. Current source, test, result, supporting-audit, and fixture manifest hashes also match.

Intercepted all five actual replay calls. PredictionCase contains only case_id/text/topics/spans; PredictionSpan contains span_id/span/text; ContextInput contains step_id and currently materialized context pairs. Nested inputs expose no evaluation labels or future context.

Predictions survived 36 hidden-gold variants and 15 unavailable-context variants. The call-site bypass mutant also failed the full test suite. No active hidden-gold or future-context dependency was found.

Direct comparisons against all 18 static gold files verified identities, offsets/text, Topic definitions, origin/kind, joint memberships, alternatives, abstention permission, and Topic components. All 52 valid contract pairs differing only in abstention permission remained distinguishable after round trip.

Representation mutants for identity collapse, semantic-field loss, alternative loss, abstention loss, and component collapse were killed. Additional serialization-loss, decoding-loss, and offset-corruption mutants were killed. Fixture generation remained unchanged with tested component functions disabled.

EV4 recount confirmed 21 annotated spans, 20 scored required spans, and 24 memberships. Required spans/memberships by kind are condition 4/4, exception 1/1, deadline 7/7, approval_constraint 2/2, decision 2/2, and supporting_evidence 4/8. One ambiguous deadline is excluded.

EV4 aggregate and category counts agree. Aggregate TP/FP/FN is 13/0/11 for span-only prediction, 24/12/0 for local-window prediction, 24/5/0 for sentence projection, and 24/0/0 for clause/EDU-like/hybrid projection. Selected-stress, non-source-complete, and gold-span-conditioned boundaries remain explicit.

Checked all eight end-to-end comparators and all 239 recorded IoU matches. Matching is one-to-one. Clause set-valued scoring has 39 gold memberships, 39 predictions, 35 matches, four FP, and four FN. Injecting a chatter prediction increases FP and the precision denominator by one; removing predictions produces 39 FN.

Rechecked 156 unit-projection rows, all four membership comparators, and all 346 stored fractions. Oracle ceilings, predicted-unit results, overlap membership, complete Topic objects, and whole-message sets remain separate tasks.

EV6 uses 200 calibration and 200 holdout examples with disjoint texts and template families. Threshold selection uses calibration only. The coverage floor rejects all-abstain success. Holdout coverage is 120/200 and accepted error is 40/120; target failure remains explicit.

STATUS.md, the replay docstring, EV5 contract metadata, and parent CURRENT_STATUS.md match the repaired target. Execution completion and pending independent acceptance remain separate before this verdict.

Acceptance applies to the current synthetic/adversarial engineering-validation target. EV7 remains synthetic-only. Topic03 identity/count, Topic04 semantic response scope, Topic10 general calibration, external-method reproduction, production representativeness, and hardware performance remain explicit handoffs or deferrals. No production-accuracy, architecture-approval, or literature-exhaustion claim was found.
Used local reads and /tmp writes only. No repository edits, network or mailbox access, commits, or git-state changes occurred. Probe evidence is retained under /tmp/msgloom-review06-7kdnbj2k.
